# Third-party component models

These models were downloaded from component libraries (GrabCAD, TraceParts, vendor sites). They belong to their authors/vendors and are **not** covered by the CERN-OHL-S licence of this project. They are therefore **not redistributed** in this repository unless the source licence explicitly allows it. Download them from the original source and place them in this folder before opening the assemblies.
